name: @nimblebraininc/jsonplaceholder
description: MCP server for the JSONPlaceholder API - fake REST API for testing and prototyping

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: List posts, optionally filtered by user ID

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Get a single post by ID

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List comments, optionally filtered by post ID

tools.name: get_post_comments
tools.description: Get all comments for a specific post

tools.name: list_albums
tools.description: List albums, optionally filtered by user ID

tools.name: get_album_photos
tools.description: Get all photos in a specific album

tools.name: list_photos
tools.description: List photos, optionally filtered by album ID

tools.name: get_photo
tools.description: Get a single photo by ID

tools.name: list_todos
tools.description: List todos, optionally filtered by user ID or completion status

tools.name: get_todo
tools.description: Get a single todo by ID

tools.name: get_user_todos
tools.description: Get all todos for a specific user

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Get a single user by ID
